scope: A row's class applies to every cell of each receipt it lists: the measured content is a receipt-level producing input.
compiled_files: only compiled production files take part: `.rs` files, `Cargo.toml`, and the non-Markdown files a current `.rs` file names in a literal `include!`, `include_str!` or `include_bytes!`

receipt_classes.code-identical: the row's basis proves the measured production code equal to the current tree
receipt_classes.code-differs: the row's basis shows a difference; `differing_files` names each differing file
receipt_classes.unresolvable: the receipt pins neither production files nor a resolvable source revision; `unresolved_inputs` names its pinned producing inputs

bases.production files: the compiled files under `crates/` the producing snapshot pins, against the tree: identical or comment-or-blank-only is equal; code-differs, removed, and a tracked `src/` file the receipt does not pin (added) differ
bases.production files at the source revision: the snapshot pins no file under `crates/`; the compiled files of every package under `crates/` at the `source_revision` the receipt records, read as bytes, against the tree by the same file classes
bases.measured bytes unavailable: no snapshot of the row holds the measured bytes of a pinned file whose current bytes differ
bases.measured content not pinned: the snapshot pins no file under `crates/` and no recorded `source_revision` resolves

classifier_rule: Rust sources only. Line comments (`//` to the end of the line, doc comments included) and block comments (`/* */`, nested) outside string, raw-string, byte-string and character literals are removed; trailing whitespace is removed from every line; lines left empty are removed. Two files whose remaining text is equal are comment-or-blank-only. Leading whitespace, line breaks inside code and `#[doc]` attributes count as code.
